title: Early Versus Late Administration of Insulin Glargine in T1DM During Fasting Ramadan
brief_summary: To compare different timing of insulin Glargine administration (early-6 pm versus standard bedtime-10 pm) as part of standard of care in patients with type1 diabetes who wish to fast the month of Ramadan.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

1. DM type 1
2. Age \> 14 years
3. Diagnosis of type 1 DM of more than 6 months.
4. Committed to do SMBG

Exclusion Criteria:

1. Renal and hepatic impairment
2. Adrenal insufficiency
3. Pregnancy
4. Alcohol consumption
5. Any diagnosed psychiatric disease
